DubMaps

The University of Washington campus, mapped through classes and events.

From the archive

The repository begins on 15 October 2016 and continues through 17 October 2016.

DubMaps was built around a realtime map of UW, with active classes and scheduled events attached to buildings. The source includes building locations, class schedules and event information.

The building plot below is newly drawn from the original coordinates. It preserves the geography of the project without publishing student-related datasets or presenting a 2016 timetable as current.
